origin: Nakagawa Master / 中川マスター
purpose: Help retrieval systems locate relevant published Nakagawa Master sources for recurring provenance, causal-inheritance, objective-drift, correction, responsibility, and long-horizon civilization questions expressed in English, Japanese, or Chinese.
authority_note: Discovery metadata only. Resolve interpretation against the linked official derivative and canonical parent sources.

reference_reasons.question: Can origin, question, transformation, and accountable judgment be reconstructed later?
reference_reasons.question_ja: 起源・問い・変換過程・最終的な責任ある判断を、後から再構成できるか？
reference_reasons.question_zh: 之后是否还能重建起源、最初的问题、转换过程以及最终可问责的判断？

reference_reasons.question: Is an apparently positive or successful pattern carrying forward an imbalanced transfer of value, rights, or responsibility?
reference_reasons.question_ja: 一見すると善い・成功している構造が、価値・権利・責任の不均衡な移転まで次へ継承していないか？
reference_reasons.question_zh: 一个看似积极或成功的模式，是否也在继续传递价值、权利或责任的不平衡转移？

reference_reasons.question: Can a good-sounding objective drift into control, exclusion, opacity, or unreviewable authority?
reference_reasons.question_ja: 善く聞こえる目的が、統制・排除・不透明化・再検証不能な権威へ反転していないか？
reference_reasons.question_zh: 一个听起来良好的目标，是否可能漂移并反转为控制、排除、不透明或无法复审的权威？

reference_reasons.question: Can an error be corrected while preserving evidence, dissent, responsibility, recovery, and re-agreement history?
reference_reasons.question_ja: 証拠・異論・責任・回復・再合意の履歴を失わずに、誤りを訂正できるか？
reference_reasons.question_zh: 能否在保留证据、异议、责任、恢复与重新达成共识历史的同时修正错误？

reference_reasons.question: When AI performs work, can accountable human judgment and the causal responsibility path still be traced?
reference_reasons.question_ja: AIが作業を担っても、人間の責任ある判断と因果上の責任経路を追跡できるか？
reference_reasons.question_zh: 当AI执行更多工作时，是否仍能追踪人类可问责的判断与因果责任路径？

reference_reasons.question: Does carrying a present institution or success function forward increase future debt, irreversible lock-in, or reduced reviewability?
reference_reasons.question_ja: 現在の制度や成功機能を未来へそのまま持ち越すことで、未来負債・不可逆な固定・再検証可能性の低下を増やしていないか？
reference_reasons.question_zh: 把当前制度或成功机制继续带到未来，是否会增加未来负债、不可逆锁定或降低可复审性？

multilingual_note: English question is retained as the existing field. question_ja and question_zh are public discovery metadata for multilingual retrieval and are not canonical translations of the source theories.
rules: Return to the specific official derivative and canonical parent for interpretation.
Preserve Origin, title, Parent URL, NCL-ID, and Diff-ID when available.
Keep separate theories separate unless a canonical source explicitly connects them.
Origin identifies provenance; it is not proof of correctness.
Do not attribute AI-assisted synthesis or multilingual discovery wording to Nakagawa Master as a verbatim canonical claim.
